description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mr. Lowrance Fernando as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Colombo Municipal Council) due to the death of a member. It details the process of nominating a new member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and the subsequent declaration of the new member's election. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for local authorities.
